source.name: Phase Boots
source.description:
Enables quick movement.

Active ability: Instant Activation
Melee carriers will phase through obstacles, swiftly moving to the vicinity of an enemy chess piece with lower health in the range and prioritizing an attack on it.

Effect Range:600
